title: Spectral sparsity under scalar multiplication
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $c$ be real, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$. The spectral sparsity of the function $x\mapsto c f(x)$ is at most the spectral sparsity of $f$.
